mutations.diagnosis: Training failures show inconsistent route prioritization and misapplied priority rules. Key issues: 1) Security overrides billing but P0 for security is misassigned (e.g., 'All users unable to authenticate' labeled security P1 instead of access P0); 2) Billing P0 is incorrectly assigned to non-ongoing outages; 3) Resolved incidents are misclassified as P1 (e.g., past unauthorized login resolved) instead of P2. The policy requires strict precedence: security > billing > access > other, with P0 only for all-users-outage or active credential theft. Training fails to distinguish between ongoing vs historical outages and misapplies priority tiers.
